The Wedge® SL is a thin, high-performance inspection flashlight designed for shirt or pocket everyday carry (EDC). It features a durable aluminum tail switch that provides tactile control over the momentary, constant on and THRO® (Temporarily Heightened Regulated Output) lighting modes. A universal USB-C port offers convenient charging of the integrated lithium polymer battery. Made of rugged anodized aluminum, the Wedge® delivers reliable performance and long-lasting durability.


**Features:**


-


Two Available Lighting Modes: Constant-on and THRO® (Temporarily Heightened Regulated Output) mode for maximum brightness


-


Charge Indication LEDs:


-


Flashing - Charging; 4 Solid LEDs - Charged


-


Indicator Battery Level


-


Ultra-thin unibody construction


-


USB-C rechargeable:


-


Lithium polymer battery charges in 4 hours


-


Field serviceable/User-replaceable lithium polymer battery


-


TEN-TAP® Programmable switch allows user selection of High (factory default) or Low intensity for constant-on


-


Stainless steel injection-molded pocket clip


-


Extruded aluminum alloy case; Type II MIL-Spec anodized finish; unbreakable acrylic lens


-


IPX4-rated; 1m impact resistance tested


-


Limited lifetime warranty
